name: Schüco
note: Main and shirt sponsor of Arminia Bielefeld since 2016, contract until June 2028. Not rated yet: the ownership claim (schueco-ownership) only identifies the legal entity from its legal notice (Schüco International KG, Bielefeld Local Court HRA 8135), not who owns it. Schüco’s own site (https://www.schueco.com/de-ch/unternehmen/ueber-schueco/otto-fuchs-gruppe, opened 2026-10-01) says Schüco has been a subsidiary of OTTO FUCHS KG, a company of the OTTO FUCHS group, since 1964; who owns OTTO FUCHS isn’t sourced yet. It needs sourced claims for both steps before it can be rated.
